Definition: from G5548; an unguent or smearing, i.e. (figuratively) the special endowment ("chrism") of the Holy Spirit:--anointing, unction.
BiblicalUsage: The anointing is the gift every believer has received from the Holy One, and John says it teaches them all things. It abides in them, so they do not need a teacher who would lead them away.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the anointing John means is the Spirit Himself, given to ordinary believers, and no believer is left without a teacher.
